name: Kiwix
description: Kiwix enables you to access offline content from Wikipedia, Project Gutenberg, Stack Exchange, and more. Perfect for education, research, or areas with limited internet connectivity. Requires ZIM archive files.

notes.title: Setup Requirements
notes.content: This container requires a bind-mounted directory containing ZIM archive files. You will be prompted for the path during installation. Download ZIM archives from https://library.kiwix.org or https://download.kiwix.org/zim/
